children: Sodexo's ability to deliver on its new strategy remains critical after several challenging years, Bernstein's Sabrina Blanc writes in a note. The French food-services company's new turnaround and growth plan marks a genuine reset for the group, she says. While the strategy appears compelling, with a simplified business model and renewed focus on commercial execution, Bernstein keeps a cautious stance at this stage. The French food-services company still needs to show consistent delivery across markets and commercial momentum, among other elements, she says. "Investors will need to see evidence of progress before fully embracing the group's medium-term ambitions," she adds. Shares are up 0.3% at 58.65 euros. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
